admission.justification: The tool-server case round-trips the sprint-less shape for a manager, worker, reviewer and curator and a master-only investigator, and refuses a sprint-bound role without its sprint.

applicability: A launched role whose selection names a master.
conditions: The binding carries the references the selection actually has.
exclusions: A start that names no document.
A sprint-bound role such as the orchestrator, whose one shape stays sprint-only.
statement: A launched role on a master that no sprint commands carries a binding without a sprint reference, and the tool server accepts it.
